chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 57: The Spirit-Dancer Arrives at Camp
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang gathers intelligence on local spirit-dancers as a potential solution to Danyangzi. But his campfire peace is shattered by a grinning old man with a drum and a veiled woman in blood-red shoes.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 57 — The Spirit-Dancer
og_description: A wandering medium and his silent, veiled wife step out of the darkness. Li Huowang must decide: ally or threat?
twitter_title: Ch. 57 — A drum, a veil, and a cry into the woods.
twitter_description: The night is no longer quiet. A spirit-dancer has found Li Huowang’s fire.
